validation.execution: Apple Clang SDK27.2 Release WFS_FSKIT=ON; disposable source without Git metadata; deny-default sandbox denies home/keychain/publishing paths; loopback-only test transport. fs-rename allowed only on exact owned reference/native mount roots. Signed module installed separately.
validation.unit_scope: LevelDB and legacy flat layouts: default/missing label, UTF-8 and invalid names, 255-byte bound, identity/root-time preservation, no-op sequence stability, label-only/escaped JSON diff, fork and revision isolation, restore safety, reopen and GC. Raw RPC malformed input and both FSKit callback transports included.

limits: Volume label is optional namespace metadata, separate from root inode flags, World name, repository ID, descriptor/volume identity and mount path. Missing record means ForkFS. Existing inode/tree/revision formats are unchanged.

Older namespace verifiers reject selected trees containing the added metadata record. Older frontends do not display the persisted name; the new frontend requires the new daemon RPC. No automatic downgrade/migration is claimed.

Native qualification is private single-user macOS27.2.1 with listed ATTR_VOL_NAME operations; Finder/diskutil integration, arbitrary concurrent mounts, persistent file IDs and power-loss behavior are not qualified.
APFS reference used a newly created 256 MiB sparse image and verified image/mount ownership. No host or preexisting user volume was renamed.
